ui.about.title: About HelpSetu
ui.about.p1: HelpSetu is a free directory of essential Indian services. It helps you find the right helpline, understand what to do, call the verified number, and open the official website.
ui.about.p2: Every listing shows its official source and the date it was checked. Numbers are added only after they are matched against an official government or service-provider page.
ui.about.p3: HelpSetu is not an official government app and is not connected to any department. When a number changes, the official page is always the final answer.
ui.about.callout: In any emergency, call 112 first. It connects you to police, fire and ambulance services anywhere in India.
ui.about.how1: A number is matched digit by digit with an official government or provider page.
ui.about.how2: The source link and the date of checking are shown on every service.
ui.about.how3: If a source cannot be checked, the listing is not published.
ui.about.how4: State services are shown only for that state — never as an all-India number.
ui.about.offlineText: The complete directory is saved on your device after the first visit. You can read numbers and open the dialler without internet.
ui.about.privacyText: No account, no tracking, no ads, no location permission. Your saved services and recents stay on this device.
ui.about.disclaimer: HelpSetu is an independent directory. It is not affiliated with the Government of India or any government department.
ui.privacy.title: Privacy
ui.privacy.p1: HelpSetu does not ask you to create an account. It does not collect your name, phone number, PNR, bank details or location.
ui.privacy.p2: Your language choice, theme, selected state, saved services and recently used services are stored only in this browser or app on your device. They are never sent to a server.

states.DH: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

steps: Call 112 for police, fire and ambulance.
Do not move an injured person unless there is immediate danger.
Give the exact location and nearest landmark.
highway-accident.title: Road accident

gas-leak.title: Gas leak or gas smell
steps: Do not switch any electrical switch on or off.
Turn off the regulator if safe, open windows and take everyone outside.
Call 1906 from outside. If there is fire or injury, call 112.

online-financial-fraud.title: Online money fraud
steps: Call 1930 right now — the first hours matter most.
Call your bank and ask to block the transaction or card.
Keep screenshots and transaction IDs, then file on cybercrime.gov.in.

consumer-refund.title: Refund, bad product or shop problem
steps: Keep the bill, order number and payment proof.
Call 1915 or WhatsApp +91 88000 01915.
Save the complaint number for tracking.

need-ambulance.title: Need an ambulance
steps: Call 108 for an emergency ambulance.
Give the exact address and nearest landmark.
For pregnancy transport, 102 is the maternal ambulance.

fire.title: Fire emergency
steps: Move everyone away from the fire.
Call 112 and give the full address and floor.
Do not go back inside for belongings.

woman-in-danger.title: Woman in danger or being harassed
steps: For immediate danger, call 112.
Call 181 for support, a One Stop Centre or legal help.
Keep your phone and important documents with you if safe.

lost-child.title: Lost child or child in danger
steps: Call 1098. If there is immediate danger, call 112 too.
Give the child's name, age and last seen place.
Stay nearby and keep your phone reachable.

train-toilet-dirty.title: Dirty train toilet or coach
steps: Note your PNR, coach and berth number.
Take a photo if it is safe.
Call 139 or file on RailMadad and keep the complaint number.

train-late-status.title: Train is late or where is it?
steps: Open NTES and enter the train number.
Check the live position and platform.
Also check the station display board before boarding.

train-seat-availability.title: Check seat availability
steps: Open IRCTC and enter stations, date and class.
Check availability before paying.
HelpSetu does not show live seats itself — IRCTC is the official source.

pnr-status.title: Check PNR status
steps: Open the PNR page.
Enter the 10-digit PNR from your ticket.
Do not share your PNR publicly.

train-security-medical.title: Security or medical help on a train
phrases: someone is harassing me on train
steps: Move near other passengers if you can.
Call 139 for railway security or medical help
For immediate danger, call 112.

highway-breakdown.title: Vehicle broken down on a highway
steps: Park on the side and turn on hazard lights.
Call 1033 with highway number, direction and nearest kilometre stone.
Stand behind the crash barrier, away from traffic.

mental-distress.title: Feeling very low or in crisis
steps: Call 14416 for free, confidential mental health support.
You do not need a diagnosis to call.
If there is immediate danger, call 112 or go to a hospital.

elder-abuse.title: Older person needs help
steps: Call 14567 between 8 AM and 8 PM.
Keep pension and medical papers ready.
For immediate danger, call 112.

legal-help.title: Free legal help
steps: Call 15100 and explain the problem.
Ask which documents are needed for free legal aid.

passport-help.title: Passport application or renewal
steps: Register on passportindia.gov.in.
Fill the form, pay online and book a slot.
Take original documents and photocopies.

electricity-water.title: No electricity or water
steps: Choose your state first, then pick your electricity or water board.
For a live wire or dangerous situation, call 112 and keep everyone away.

train-lost-item.title: Lost something on a train
steps: Call 139 and give your PNR, coach, seat and a description of the item.
File a lost-property complaint on RailMadad.
Also inform the station master if you are still at the station.

bank-atm-problem.title: Bank or ATM problem
steps: Complain to your bank first and keep the complaint number.
Wait 30 days for a reply.
If unresolved, use the RBI complaint portal.
If it is fraud, call 1930 immediately.

online-harassment.title: Online harassment or blackmail
steps: Do not pay or send more photos.
Save screenshots, profile links and messages.
File on cybercrime.gov.in; call 1930 if money was taken.
Call 181 if you need support.

poison-snakebite.title: Poisoning or snake bite
steps: Call 1800-116-117 for poison advice.
Call 112 or 108 if the person is unconscious or struggling to breathe.
Keep the packet or medicine strip for the doctor.

rbi-cms-portal.name: RBI complaint portal — banking problems
rbi-cms-portal.purpose: Official Reserve Bank of India portal to complain if your bank or payment operator does not solve a problem in 30 days.
rbi-cms-portal.when: Wrong charges, failed ATM withdrawal, unauthorised transaction, or a bank complaint ignored for 30 days.
steps: First complain to your bank and keep the complaint number.
Wait 30 days for the bank to reply.
If not resolved, open the RBI Complaint Management System.
For money lost in online fraud, call 1930 immediately as well.

consumer-1915.name: National Consumer Helpline — 1915
consumer-1915.purpose: Free help with problems about shops, online orders, refunds, faulty products and services. Call, WhatsApp or register a complaint online.
consumer-1915.when: The seller is not responding, a refund is refused, you got a wrong or damaged item, or you were overcharged.
steps: Keep the bill, order number, payment proof and chat screenshots ready.
Call 1915 or send a WhatsApp message to +91 88000 01915.
Write down your complaint number and use it to track the complaint.
If it is still not solved, file the complaint on the consumer helpline website.

national-cybercrime-1930.name: Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 — financial fraud
national-cybercrime-1930.purpose: Report online and financial frauds (UPI, net-banking and similar). Prompt calls feed a system linked with banks so fraudulent transactions can be frozen. Full complaints can also be filed on cybercrime.gov.in, which has an anonymous section for women and children.
national-cybercrime-1930.when: Money has been taken through UPI, a card, net-banking, a fake link or an online investment scam.
steps: Call 1930 immediately. The first few hours give the best chance of freezing the money.
Call your bank and ask them to block the transaction or card.
Keep the transaction ID, screenshots, caller number and UPI ID.
File a full complaint on cybercrime.gov.in.
Change your passwords and never pay more money to recover the lost amount.

cybercrime-portal.name: Cybercrime portal — file a complaint
cybercrime-portal.purpose: Official National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. Report financial fraud, fake profiles, harassment, hacking and child abuse material.
cybercrime-portal.when: You lost money online, or you are being blackmailed, harassed or hacked online.
steps: For money fraud, call 1930 immediately — the first few hours matter most.
Also inform your bank so the transaction can be frozen.
Open cybercrime.gov.in and choose Report Cyber Crime.
Keep screenshots, transaction IDs, phone numbers and profile links ready.
Never pay a blackmailer and never share OTP or passwords.

national-coastguard-sar-1554.name: Coast Guard maritime distress line 1554
national-coastguard-sar-1554.purpose: Nationwide maritime search-and-rescue distress number — the call reaches the respective Coast Guard MRCC/MRSC, which coordinates rescue at sea.

national-erss-112.name: Emergency 112 — Police, Fire & Medical
national-erss-112.purpose: Single national number for immediate police, fire & rescue or medical emergencies. Calls route to the Emergency Response Centre of the State/UT you are in.
national-erss-112.when: Any danger to life or property: accident, fire, crime, a medical emergency, or if you feel unsafe.
steps: Stay as calm as you can and call 112.
Say your exact location and a nearby landmark first.
Tell them what happened and how many people need help.
Do not hang up until the operator says you can.
Keep your phone reachable so the team can call back.

fire-101-legacy.name: Fire — old number 101
fire-101-legacy.purpose: In many states 101 still reaches the fire service. 112 is the nationwide number that works everywhere for fire, police and medical emergencies.
fire-101-legacy.when: There is a fire, smoke, or someone is trapped. If you are not sure, call 112.
steps: Move people away from the fire first. Do not go back inside.
Call 112. Say the full address, floor, landmark and whether anyone is trapped.
If a small fire is safe to smother, use a fire extinguisher or a thick blanket. Never use water on an electrical or oil fire.
Stay on the line and keep your phone reachable for the fire team.

national-moefcc-forestfire-1800119334.name: Forest fire & chemical disaster helpline (MoEFCC)
national-moefcc-forestfire-1800119334.purpose: 24-hour toll-free helpline of MoEFCC's Disaster Management Cell to monitor incidents involving fires (including forest fires) and chemical disasters in States and Union Territories.

national-imd-weather-duty.name: IMD Weather Duty Officer (national queries)
national-imd-weather-duty.purpose: IMD headquarters duty-officer line for weather-related national queries; a separate duty-officer line (011-24344377/4599) covers cyclone-related queries. IMD publishes no dedicated toll-free national weather helpline.

national-ndma-helpline-1078.name: National Disaster Helpline 1078 (NDMA)
national-ndma-helpline-1078.purpose: NDMA's round-the-clock toll-free four-digit helpline, handled at the NDMA control room, for disaster-related assistance and coordination.
national-ndma-helpline-1078.when: A flood, cyclone, earthquake, landslide or other disaster has happened or is likely.
steps: For immediate danger to life, call 112 first.
Call 1078 for disaster information and coordination.
Follow instructions from local authorities and move to higher, safer ground if told to.
Do not spread unverified messages.

national-ndma-control-room.name: NDMA Control Room (New Delhi)
national-ndma-control-room.purpose: Control room landline at NDMA Bhawan, New Delhi for disaster monitoring and coordination. Email: controlroom@ndma.gov.in.

national-ndrf-helpline.name: NDRF Helpline (National Disaster Response Force)
national-ndrf-helpline.purpose: Published helpline of the National Disaster Response Force for rescue and disaster-response assistance.

in-lpg-emergency-1906.name: LPG Emergency Helpline 1906
in-lpg-emergency-1906.purpose: Pan-India 24x7 multilingual helpline for attending emergency LPG leakage complaints, with mechanic and field support.
in-lpg-emergency-1906.when: You smell gas, hear a hiss from the cylinder or regulator, or a gas fire has just started.
steps: Do not switch any light, fan, match or mobile phone on or off inside the room.
Turn off the cylinder regulator if you can reach it safely.
Open doors and windows, and take everyone outside.
Call 1906 from outside. If there is a fire or someone is hurt, call 112.
Do not re-enter until a trained person says it is safe.

digilocker-portal.name: DigiLocker — digital documents
digilocker-portal.purpose: Official digital wallet for Aadhaar, driving licence, PAN, marksheets, vehicle RC and other documents issued by government.
digilocker-portal.when: You need to show or download a government document, or keep a backup before travelling.
steps: Open digilocker.gov.in or install the official DigiLocker app.
Sign in with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Choose the document you need and download or share it.
Do not share your Aadhaar OTP with anyone.

national-nalsa-15100.name: NALSA Free Legal Aid Helpline 15100
national-nalsa-15100.purpose: Urgent legal assistance and free legal aid. Applications can also be submitted online through nalsa.gov.in.
national-nalsa-15100.when: You cannot afford a lawyer, need legal aid, or do not know your rights.
steps: Call 15100 and explain your legal problem.
Ask which documents are needed for free legal aid.
You can also apply through the NALSA website or your District Legal Services Authority.

india-gov-portal.name: National Portal of India — directory
india-gov-portal.purpose: Official starting point for central and state government websites, schemes, forms and helpline directories.
india-gov-portal.when: You cannot find the right government department or helpline.
steps: Open india.gov.in.
Use the search box or the Services menu.
Check the official department website address before paying any fee.

passport-seva-portal.name: Passport Seva
passport-seva-portal.purpose: Official Ministry of External Affairs portal to apply for a new passport, renew one, book an appointment and track status.
passport-seva-portal.when: You need a passport application, renewal, police clearance or appointment.
steps: Register on the official Passport Seva website.
Fill the form and pay the fee online.
Book a slot at your nearest Passport Seva Kendra.
Carry original documents and photocopies to the appointment.

umang-portal.name: UMANG — government services in one app
umang-portal.purpose: Official Government of India app and website for many central and state services: EPFO, gas booking, Ayushman, pensions, land records and more.
umang-portal.when: You need a government service but do not know which department or website to use.
steps: Open UMANG or install it from your app store.
Sign in with your mobile number.
Search for the service by name.
Use only the official UMANG app or web.umang.gov.in.

national-maternal-102.name: 102 Maternal & newborn transport (JSSK)
national-maternal-102.purpose: NHM patient-transport ambulance system, primarily used to take pregnant women to facilities for institutional delivery and to transport sick infants.
national-maternal-102.when: A pregnant woman needs transport for delivery, or a sick newborn needs a hospital.
steps: Call 102 and say that this is a pregnancy or newborn transport.
Give the address and the hospital name if one is already chosen.
For an accident or other emergency, call 108 or 112 instead.

national-ambulance-108.name: 108 Emergency Ambulance (National Ambulance Service)
national-ambulance-108.purpose: Calling 108 summons an NHM-supported emergency ambulance — primarily for critical care patients, trauma and accident victims — answered by the service operating in your State/UT. Operational in 36 States/UTs.
national-ambulance-108.when: Someone is badly hurt, unconscious, bleeding or needs urgent hospital transport.
steps: Call 108 or 112 and give the exact location and landmark.
Say what happened and how many people are hurt.
Do not move an injured person unless there is immediate danger.
Keep the phone reachable so the driver can call you.

national-pmjay-14555.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY helpline
national-pmjay-14555.purpose: 24x7 call centre for assistance and queries about AB PM-JAY, including registering general complaints about the scheme.
national-pmjay-14555.when: You need to check or use your Ayushman card, find a hospital, or complain about the scheme.
steps: Call 14555 and say you need Ayushman Bharat help.
Keep your Ayushman card or Aadhaar number ready.
Ask for a listed hospital near you.

national-vayvandana-1800110770.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana helpline (70+ senior citizens)
national-vayvandana-1800110770.purpose: Beneficiaries aged 70 and above can give a missed call on this number to get assistance with the senior-citizen health coverage scheme.
national-vayvandana-1800110770.when: You are 70 or older and want help with the Ayushman Vay Vandana health cover.
steps: Give a missed call to 1800-110-770.
Keep your Aadhaar and mobile number ready.
Ask at the hospital Ayushman counter if the missed call does not work.

national-poison-aiims.name: National Poisons Information Centre (AIIMS New Delhi)
national-poison-aiims.purpose: If someone has been poisoned, call any time for poison information and management guidance from poison-information specialists.
national-poison-aiims.when: Someone swallowed poison, took too much medicine, or was bitten by a snake.
steps: Call 1800-116-117 for poison advice.
Call 112 or 108 if the person is unconscious, fits or has trouble breathing.
Do not make the person vomit unless a doctor tells you to.
Keep the packet, bottle or medicine strip to show the doctor.
For an accident or injury, call 112 first.
For breakdown or towing on a national highway, call 1033.
Open Rajmarg Yatra to file a complaint or check highway services.
Note the kilometre stone or toll plaza name to give your location.
rajmarg-yatra-portal.name: Rajmarg Yatra — highway help
rajmarg-yatra-portal.purpose: NHAI's official portal for highway complaints, toll and FASTag issues, route planning and emergency help.
rajmarg-yatra-portal.when: Vehicle breakdown, bad road, toll overcharging, FASTag problem or an accident on a national highway.

pnr-portal.name: Check PNR status
pnr-portal.purpose: Official Indian Railways PNR enquiry: check whether your ticket is confirmed, waitlisted or cancelled.
pnr-portal.when: You have a 10-digit PNR number from your ticket.
steps: Open the official PNR enquiry page.
Type the 10-digit PNR printed on your ticket.
Check the coach, berth and current status. Never share your PNR publicly.
Call 139 if the website does not work.

irctc-portal.name: IRCTC — book train tickets
irctc-portal.purpose: The official Indian Railways website for booking tickets, checking seat availability and managing a booking.
irctc-portal.when: You want to book a train ticket or check whether a seat is available.
steps: Open the official IRCTC website or the IRCTC Rail Connect app.
Enter the station names, journey date and class.
Check availability before paying. HelpSetu never shows live seats itself.
Book only on IRCTC and keep your PNR safe.

ntes-portal.name: NTES — live train running status
ntes-portal.purpose: Official National Train Enquiry System for live running status, expected arrival, platform number and train schedule.
ntes-portal.when: Your train is late, you want to know its platform, or someone is coming to receive you.
steps: Open NTES and choose Running Status.
Enter the train number or train name.
Select your journey date and station to see the live position.
Platform numbers can change — check the station display board too.

rail-madad-portal.name: RailMadad — railway complaint portal
rail-madad-portal.purpose: File a train or station complaint online with photos, and track the reply. Run by Indian Railways.
rail-madad-portal.when: Dirty toilet or coach, no water, AC or fan not working, bed bugs, staff behaviour, dirty station, or lost belongings.
steps: Note your PNR, train number, coach and berth or seat number.
Take a photo if it is safe to do so.
Open RailMadad and choose Train Complaint or Station Complaint.
Enter your journey details, describe the problem and attach the photo.
Save the complaint number and track the reply on the website.

national-railmadad-139.name: RailMadad — Railway security & medical assistance
national-railmadad-139.purpose: Railway helpline for security and medical assistance on trains and at stations, plus grievances, feedback and enquiries through RailMadad.
national-railmadad-139.when: You need railway security or medical help, or want to complain about a dirty coach, toilet, water, AC, staff or a station.
steps: Keep your PNR, train number, coach and seat or berth number ready.
Call 139 and clearly say whether you need security, medical help or want to complain.
For a cleanliness complaint with a photo, use RailMadad as well.
For immediate danger on a train, also call 112.

national-poison-cmc-vellore.name: Poison Control Centre (CMC Vellore)
national-poison-cmc-vellore.purpose: 24x7 advice on poisoning and snakebite cases from the toxicology team at CMC Vellore's Poison Control Centre.

national-telemanas-14416.name: Tele-MANAS — mental health helpline
national-telemanas-14416.purpose: A trained counsellor answers your call, assesses your mental-health needs and, if needed, refers you to a specialist, including video consultation with e-prescription. Available in 20 Indian languages; calls route to Tele MANAS cells in your State/UT.
national-telemanas-14416.when: You feel very sad, anxious, hopeless, or are thinking of hurting yourself. Someone else can call for you.
steps: Call 14416. The call is free and confidential.
You do not need a diagnosis or a document to call.
If you are in immediate danger, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
Stay with the person if a friend or family member is in crisis.

national-nhai-highway-1033.name: National Highway Helpline 1033 (NHAI)
national-nhai-highway-1033.purpose: 24x7 toll-free assistance on NHAI tolled national highways — report road accidents and get ambulance, highway patrol or crane/towing dispatched; complaints on toll plazas, FASTag and road conditions.
national-nhai-highway-1033.when: Vehicle breakdown, accident, towing needed, or a toll / FASTag problem on a national highway.
steps: Move to the side of the road and turn on hazard lights if you can.
Call 1033. For injury or immediate danger, call 112 first.
Give the highway number, direction, nearest kilometre stone or toll plaza and your vehicle number.
Stay behind the crash barrier, away from traffic, until help arrives.

national-airsewa-grievance.name: AirSewa — air travel grievance portal (MoCA)
national-airsewa-grievance.purpose: National portal to lodge grievances against airlines, airports or air-travel issues; published support numbers handle AirSewa-related queries.

national-tourist-infoline-1363.name: Incredible India Tourist Infoline
national-tourist-infoline-1363.purpose: 24x7 toll-free multi-lingual helpline for domestic and international tourists: travel information and advice on what to do in distress while travelling in India, alerting authorities if needed. Also reachable as short code 1363.
national-tourist-infoline-1363.when: You are travelling in India and need tourist information, help or a complaint.
steps: Tell them your city and the help you need.
For an emergency, always call 112 first.

national-childhelpline-1098.name: Child Helpline 1098 — child protection
national-childhelpline-1098.purpose: 24x7 outreach for children in distress or in need of care and protection. Calls are handled by the State WCD Control Room and district Child Helpline Unit, which link children to rescue, emergency services and long-term care.
national-childhelpline-1098.when: A child is lost, hurt, abused, working in a dangerous job, or in any danger.
steps: Call 1098. If there is immediate danger, call 112 as well.
Give the child's name, age, what they were wearing and the last place seen.
Do not share photos of the child publicly without advice.
Stay nearby and keep your phone reachable.

national-elderline-14567.name: Elderline 14567 — senior citizens
national-elderline-14567.purpose: Toll-free helpline for senior citizens: information, guidance, field intervention and emotional support, including elder abuse, health, old-age homes, legal aid, pensions and rescue of homeless elderly.
national-elderline-14567.when: An older person is being abused, neglected, needs help with a pension or health, or has nowhere safe to stay.
steps: Call 14567 between 8 AM and 8 PM.
Explain the problem and the person's age and location.
For immediate danger or abuse, call 112 or 181.
Keep documents like pension papers and medical records ready.

national-depwd-14456.name: National Helpline for Divyangjan 14456
national-depwd-14456.purpose: IVRS-based national disability information helpline. IVRS runs 24x7; a call-attendant is available 9:00 AM–5:30 PM on working days. DEPwD's Divya voicebot and WhatsApp chatbot provide the same assistance.
national-depwd-14456.when: You need information about disability certificates, schemes, assistive devices, pensions or rights.
steps: Call 14456. You can also message the Divya WhatsApp chatbot.
Keep your disability certificate or UDID number ready if you have one.
Ask for the state office contact if local help is needed.

national-ncw-7827170170.name: NCW 24x7 Women Helpline 7827-170-170
national-ncw-7827170170.purpose: 24x7 helpline providing online support to women in distress by referring and linking them with the concerned police, hospitals and legal services authorities.

national-women-police-1091.name: Women distress line 1091 — police response
national-women-police-1091.purpose: Distress calls with police response, listed in the national advisory alongside ERSS 112 and 181. Availability and scope can vary by State/UT — 112 remains the primary emergency number.
national-women-police-1091.when: Harassment, stalking or a safety problem where you need police help.
steps: For immediate danger, call 112.
Call 1091 to reach the women's police response where available.
Note the officer's name and the complaint number.

national-womenhelpline-181.name: Women Helpline 181 — Mission Shakti
national-womenhelpline-181.purpose: Toll-free 24-hour service for any woman in distress or facing violence, or someone calling on her behalf. The operator connects her to ERSS (112) for police, fire or ambulance and to One Stop Centres for legal support and counselling. Not operational in West Bengal — there, call 112 or the NCW helpline.
national-womenhelpline-181.when: Domestic violence, harassment, abuse, or any woman in distress — also if you are calling for someone else.
steps: If there is immediate physical danger, call 112 first.
Call 181 and tell the operator what is happening.
Ask for a One Stop Centre if you need shelter, medical or legal help.
Keep your phone and important documents with you if it is safe.
